name: Customer and brand owner exchange direct messages
description: Verify a customer can contact a brand and the brand owner can open the dashboard inbox, reply, and see the reply persisted in the conversation.
steps: Actor A signs in as a customer and opens a product
Actor A chooses Message Brand and verifies the selected product card and prefilled availability/size inquiry appear
Actor A edits or sends the inquiry about the product
Actor B signs in as the owner of that brand
Actor B opens Messages from the brand dashboard navigation
Actor B opens Actor A's conversation and sends a reply
Actor A reopens Messages and verifies the reply appears in the same thread
expected: The brand owner can find and reply to the customer's conversation from the brand dashboard, and both actors see the exchanged messages in the same thread.

name: Brand subscription request and 14-day free trial
description: Verify a new brand owner receives a 14-day trial and can submit an M-Pesa reference for review after it expires.
steps: Sign in as a brand owner
Open the brand dashboard
Verify the trial ends 14 days after its start date
Review the KES 400 per month subscription card
Enter a valid M-Pesa transaction reference
Submit the subscription request
expected: The request is saved as pending review and the brand owner sees that storefront activation awaits admin verification.

name: Admin reviews subscription payment
description: Verify an admin can review pending brand subscription requests and approve one for 30 days.
steps: Sign in as the Vaa admin
Open subscription approvals
Review a pending brand payment reference
Approve the subscription
expected: The subscription becomes active for 30 days and the brand storefront is eligible to appear on Vaa.

name: Customer checkout and payment are disabled
description: Verify the customer-facing marketplace has no cart or checkout, and customers contact brands directly to arrange purchases.
steps: Browse products
Open a product detail panel
Verify the primary action is Message Brand and no cart icon is present
Attempt the legacy order API if available
expected: No cart, checkout, or customer payment option is available; customers can message brands, and legacy order creation returns a deprecation error.

name: Admin clears legacy order and payment history
description: Verify only the authenticated Vaa admin can delete legacy order-related records while brand subscriptions and messaging remain.
steps: Sign in as the Vaa admin
Open the admin dashboard
Choose Delete legacy order history and confirm
Verify the completion message reports deleted records
Verify the KES 400 subscription panel and Messages still work
expected: Legacy orders, brand orders, payout records, refunds, and related order notifications are removed; brand subscription records and conversations remain.

name: Mobile account dropdown opens sign-in and sign-up
description: Verify a mobile visitor can open a right-aligned account dropdown, choose sign-in or sign-up, and use the compact authentication dialog.
covers: mobile account dropdown aligned to the right screen edge
customer and brand registration role choice
steps: Open Vaa at a mobile viewport while signed out
Tap the account icon in the navbar
Verify the dropdown stays inside the viewport and aligns to the right screen edge
Verify Sign in and Sign up appear inside the dropdown
Choose Sign up and select Brand
Verify the brand verification section does not require a BRS certificate or government ID
Choose a proof type, confirm brand ownership, and submit registration
Switch to Sign in and verify the dialog remains usable
expected: Brand registration collects a proof type and ownership confirmation, stores the optional evidence link and notes with a pending verification status, and does not require business registration documents.
